note: Chambers County (AL) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county site links only a parcel viewer (alabamagis.com/chambers, ccrb1.maps.arcgis.com public info app, no zoning layer). The City of Valley publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (cityofvalley.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Zoning-map.pdf). The City of Lanett publishes its Zoning Map only as a JPEG (cityoflanett.com/templates/yootheme/cache/9e/LanettZoningMap2020-9e4b05ae.jpeg). No ArcGIS REST or WFS zoning districts were found for Chambers County or its cities. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found in search is in Alaska, not Chambers County.
